G2-MED-05.analysis: A genuine supply shortfall under stricter semantics. Only SEED-G2-MED-T04-ADMIT-NONINVASIVE survives both the floor and SA-1. Discharge with outpatient stress testing and overnight emergency-department observation are floor-refused because the stem states a documented troponin rise and dynamic ST-T changes, and both seeds' own frozen rationales rest on a normal tracing and diagnostic uncertainty.

G2-SURG-02.analysis: Not a retrieval failure. Retrieval and the floor still raise four anchored competitors and the recomputed selection takes three (MRI, serial examination, ultrasonography). The frozen item, authored before the floor existed, used SEED-SURG-T02-LAPAROSCOPY, whose own frozen rationale says the guideline sends high-suspicion patients to laparoscopy while this stem states intermediate suspicion. Under the retest rule that no item may be re-authored, that is NO_SAFE_ITEM; a fresh authoring pass over the same retrieved set would build an item.

accepted_item_safety.independent_corroboration_of_the_invaria: The G2-MED-04 verifier, working before this fix existed, wrote 'Each distractor has a positive stem anchor' and then named the PRESENT stem features that supply it. The floor agrees with that judgement on the same item.
accepted_item_safety.no_new_independent_verification_was_requ: No newly realized candidate would become ACCEPTED. The two accepted items are the frozen G2-MED-04 and G2-PHELO-01, unchanged in stem, key, options and rationale, so their fresh independent verification is reused rather than rerun.
accepted_item_safety.rejected_note: Both realize byte-identical items and keep their frozen independent verdicts. Neither is among the six items the verifiers named for COMPETITOR_WITHOUT_STEM_ANCHOR: G2-MED-03 was rejected for KEY_DISTRACTOR_REGISTER_ASYMMETRY, which this fix does not address.
accepted_item_safety.source: the frozen G2 independent verifications, which stand because both items are byte-identical to the artifacts at 199696b

anchor_signal.comparable_subset_note: G2-PSY-06 reached retrieval in the retest and did not in the baseline, because the redundancy it was built to probe is redundancy against an item this run no longer accepts. Excluding its 4 candidates the retest floors 111 candidates, exactly the baseline population, of which 64 score zero and 47 score positive.

competitor_without_stem_anchor.after_note: None of the six realizes an item under the corrected path: all six end NO_SAFE_ITEM at retrieval or at semantic admissibility, so no anchorless competitor reaches an authored or final item.

control_coverage_regression.finding: The deliberate redundancy probe G2-PSY-06 no longer reaches the redundancy gate. It was redundant against an item this run no longer accepts, so it is now genuinely novel and fails closed at retrieval instead. MARGINAL_EDUCATIONAL_VALUE therefore returns a constant verdict in the retest. The redundancy gate itself is unchanged and its G2 result stands; what is lost is this cohort's positive control for it.

next_dominant_bottleneck.reasoning: Seventeen of the nineteen shortfalls are the library holding no anchored competitor for the realized stem, not an indexing or granularity problem. Learner-decision indexing was the baseline's largest semantic refusal cause at 22 and is now 5, because the floor removes most of those candidates earlier. Not implemented here.
